items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: It was strictly a Redd Foxx routine. And I had been tellin' jokes long before I heard him.

ctx.x: Q What kind of jokes did you tell?

It was strictly a Redd Foxx routine. And I had been tellin' jokes long before I heard him. Little jokes, you know. Then when I heard him I added more, and then I was really a jokester, man. But they were a little rough for those days. Go -- I had a headache with a lotta owners, man. "You can't say that type stuff up there." I say "well, hell" cha hag we got into arguments. That was the best part of my thing. We lit up Atlantic City.... And Denver, Colorado. That's where I had the trouble....

But I still didn't have couldn't make enough money. Cause we had -- 'cause we had no agent, I mean the right agent -- he would call us up, man -- I should own a piece of the Pennsylvania Turnpike -- many times
